item.title: How 2 sisters’ BYU basketball attendance is bringing people together
item.description: Two sisters, Dixie Grimmett and Penny Spresser, are beloved BYU basketball fans.

item.title: Punxsutawney Phil is said to have seen his shadow, forecasting 6 more weeks of wintry weather
item.description: Punxsutawney Phil predicted six more weeks of wintry weather Monday, a forecast sure to disappoint many after what's already been a long, cold season across large parts of the United States.

item.title: Bad Bunny wins album of the year at the 2026 Grammy Awards, a first for a Spanish-language album
item.description: Bad Bunny won album of the year at the 2026 Grammy Awards for his critically-acclaimed “Debí Tirar Más Fotos,” closing out a surprising and history-making night.

item.title: Sheriff says ‘we do in fact have a crime scene’ in search for mom of ‘Today’ host Savannah Guthrie
item.description: An Arizona sheriff said Monday that “we do in fact have a crime scene” as authorities search for the 84-year-old mother of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie, who was reported missing over the weekend.

item.title: Utah’s snowpack hits record low average
item.description: Utah's snowpack, measured on Jan. 31, was the lowest ever recorded on that date, according to data from the U.S. Department of Agriculture.

item.title: Woman hit by truck near elementary school, in critical condition
item.description: A woman was hit while walking in a crosswalk near Uintah Elementary School on Monday. Police said she was in "extremely critical condition."

item.title: Collar cams offer a bear’s eye view into the lives of grizzlies on Alaska’s desolate North Slope
item.description: The life of one of the most remote grizzly bear populations in the world is being documented by the animals themselves, with collar cameras that provide a rare glimpse of how they survive on Alaska’s rugged and desolate North Slope.

item.title: Trump administration cuts number of sites for testing the 2030 census, focusing on the South
item.description: The Trump administration is eliminating four out of six planned locations for a 2030 census practice test.

item.title: ‘Five days, and he was gone:’ Utah mom joins cause against sextortion after death of son
item.description: George is sharing her story tonight, at the Promise2Live Safe Tech event at Sky Ridge, along side other experts on Digital addiction, sextortion, and AI manipulations affect on youth and families.

item.title: Saratoga Springs officer found not legally justified in shooting man driving away
item.description: A non-fatal 2024 shooting involving a police officer has been ruled unjustified.
